notes: Linked from https://www.tortilla.co.uk/menu/nutrition-and-allergens, hosted on Storyblok CDN. 20 pages, one table per format (medium/large burrito+bowl, salads, tacos, nachos, quesadilla, protein pots, fuel bowls, cali caesar wrap, sides, kids, breakfast, hot drinks). generic_pdf returns 0 because the header spans TWO rows: row0 has Menu Item/Energy/Protein (g), row1 has Kcal/KJ under Energy. Merging row0+row1 per column then matching kcal/protein fixes it. Rows are build-your-own COMPONENTS (wrap, rice, beans, each protein), not finished meals - names prefixed with the page section. All 258 pass protein*4<=kcal*1.15.
